serial._port_help: Run find_rfid.py to discover the correct COM port for your scanner
serial._terminator_help: Character that signals end-of-scan. Usually CR (\r) or LF (\n) for serial mode

keyboard._target_device_id_help: Run find_rfid.py and scan a card to discover your scanner's hardware ID (VID_xxxx&PID_xxxx)
keyboard._max_gap_ms_help: Max milliseconds between characters from scanner bursts. Increase if you see missed characters

server._port_help: Local loopback port. Must match the port in your classroom web app settings
